title: DILG tags 11 persons of interest in Laos drug haul
summary: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Friday named 11 “persons of interest” who were allegedly linked to the multibillion-peso narcotics shipment bound for the Philippines and intercepted in Laos.
